stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2023-2024 (fall 2023 entering class), the newest CDS Yeshiva posts. C1 prints only men and women rows (908 + 805 applied, 544 + 548 admitted, 337 + 307 enrolled); the totals shown add those two rows. The residency rows (in-state, out-of-state, international) are blank, so international applicant and admit counts are null, and Yeshiva reports no waitlist policy. C21: 129 early decision applicants, all 129 admitted (plan closing date 11/01/2023). IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator) shows 1,665 applicants, 56% admitted and 61% of those enrolled, with no counts. Test scores are optional for most applicants and only 21% submitted the SAT, so the percentiles describe a self-selected group. The CDS grid marks standardized test scores 'Very Important' while its own C8 answers 'No' to using SAT/ACT in admission decisions; the factor grid below is copied as printed. The CDS first-time counts differ slightly between C1 (644 enrolled) and B1/B2 (641). Undergraduate enrollment (2,334) and the nonresident count (180) are the CDS 'Total Undergraduates' figures for fall 2023 (College Navigator shows 2,930 undergraduates for fall 2024).
